## Description
```
Not another FAQ block. 4WP FAQ wraps the core Accordion you already use, adds FAQPage schema, and turns every question on your site into one knowledge base, shown in 60 seconds.

✅ Convert to FAQ: one click wraps the core Accordion. Your design stays the same.
🧩 FAQPage JSON-LD: schema on every page with FAQ, on or off per block.
🔎 Scan into a registry: real questions from your real pages, never typed twice. "Used in" shows where each one lives.
✏️ Edit once, update every page: a registry change is written to every page that uses the question.
📚 FSE hub: List, Categories and Search blocks, pretty category URLs and SEO titles.
🤖 AI without a vendor: category copy through the standard WordPress AI Client.
🆓 Free. No Pro tier.

⬇ Download free on WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/plugins/4wp-faq/
👉 Plugin page and docs: https://4wp.dev/plugin/4wp-faq/
💬 Live hub with 296 questions: https://4wp.dev/faqs/
⌨ GitHub: https://github.com/4wpdev/4wp-faq

Chapters
```

## Site linking (4wp.dev ↔ video)
- On https://4wp.dev/plugin/4wp-faq/ the "See it in 60 seconds" section uses the YouTube embed (or `4wp-faq-overview.mp4` with the poster), with `VideoObject` schema.
- Use the poster as the custom YouTube thumbnail.
- Add the video to a **4WP Plugins** playlist (new; separate from the Architectures playlist).
- End screen: Subscribe + link to the WordPress.org plugin page (in the description, since end screens cannot link to wordpress.org without YPP).
